The Ultrawave with Bass Nathan Navarro explores both traditional sounds as well as some profoundly non-traditional tones of the Ultrawave Bass Distortion Lab. Six Ultrawave Presets from AndyDemos Andy Martin really dove deep in the Ultrawave Distortion Lab and its Neuro Editor possibilities. Download his presets today. BassTheWorld.com Demos the Ultrawave Gregor Fris and Frank Itt explore some of the super-fuzzed and "synth-y" out-of-the-box sounds of the Ultrawave Bass Distortion Lab. Pete Thorn Demos the Ultrawave Our friend and Multiband veteran, Pete Thorn is back to explore the many unexpected sounds available in the Ultrawave. R.J Ronquillo's 10 Favorite Sounds The great R.J. Ronquillo takes us on a tour of 10 of his favorite Ultrawave Distortion Lab presets, from grinding fuzz to thumping tremolo. Mike Hermans Demos the Ultrawave Mike "Pop Into The Chemist" Hermans runs through some of the contemporary guitar sounds made possible with the Ultrawave Distortion Lab. In In-Depth Tutorial on the Ultrawave Learn the how to create, publish, and download Ultrawave Distortion Lab presets in this in-depth tour of the Neuro Desktop Editor with the Ultrawave. Do Noise Does Ultrawave Sound experimentalist Do_Noise takes the Ultrawave Distortion Lab in some unexpected yet highly musical directions. ​ Tri Pedal Review Explores UW Presets A preset showcase from Tri Pedal Reviews. Sound samples from a great collection of presets created by Ultrawave owners. Sinister Sounds from the Ultrawave Steven Lane of Noisegate Australia created this menacing Ultrawave Bass Distortion Lab preset. It's called "80's Doom!" The Ultrawave with Synthersizer Daniel Fisher of Sweetwater Sound demonstrates how the Ultrawave Distortion Lab is the perfect overdrive pedal for synthesizer. The Ultrawave Does 80s Metal! Leon Todd, THE master of 70s and 80s hard rock/metal guitar explores to possibilities of the Ultrawave Distortion Lab. Understanding Audio Compression Using the Ultrawave, Nathan Navarro explains the finer details of audio compression. ​Guitar Bonedo Gets Experimental with the UW It's all about context. Our friends at Guitar Bonedo are masters of pairing the right riff with the right sound. Huge THANKS to JHS and Sweetwater Sound for including the Ultrawave Distortion Lab in the very first episode of "What's in the Box?"
